entries.en: Before the meeting, I checked the figures in the WB report against my own notes.
entries.zh: 会议前，我把世界银行报告中的数字与自己的笔记核对了一遍。

entries.en: The organist practised Variation XVII slowly before attempting it at full speed.
entries.zh: 管风琴演奏者先慢速练习了第十七变奏，然后才尝试按原速演奏。

entries.en: "Yeh, I can stay another hour if you still need help," Sam said.
entries.zh: “是的，要是你还需要帮忙，我可以再待一个小时，”萨姆说。

entries.en: Mist filled the cwm below us, hiding the path back to the lake.
entries.zh: 雾气充满了我们下方的山侧凹地，遮住了返回湖边的小径。

entries.en: Plate XXII shows the doorway before the later repairs altered its shape.
entries.zh: 第二十二幅图版展示了那个门口在后来的修缮改变其形状之前的样子。

entries.en: After earning her BJ, Lena applied for a job at a local newspaper.
entries.zh: 莱娜获得新闻学士学位后，申请了当地一家报社的工作。

entries.en: Lew folded the map before slipping it into his coat pocket.
entries.zh: 卢把地图折好，然后放进自己的大衣口袋。

entries.en: Zzz... A soft snore drifted down from the top bunk while I was still tying my shoes.
entries.zh: 呼噜……我还在系鞋带时，上铺就传来了轻轻的鼾声。

entries.en: In the old Scottish tale, the neighbours held a foy on the evening before the family sailed away.
entries.zh: 在那则古老的苏格兰故事里，邻居们在那家人乘船离去的前一晚设宴饯行。

entries.en: Mr Koo left enough space between the chairs for a wheelchair to pass.
entries.zh: 古先生在椅子之间留出了足够的空间，方便轮椅通过。

entries.en: A retired MiG stood behind the rope barrier at the air museum.
entries.zh: 一架退役的米格飞机停在航空博物馆的绳索围栏后面。

entries.en: The old North Vietnamese ledger recorded even the smallest expenses in xu.
entries.zh: 那本旧北越账簿连最小的开支也以xu为单位记了下来。

entries.en: "Alors! Shall we go in, or are we waiting for someone else?" the French host asked.
entries.zh: “那么！我们是进去，还是还要再等别人？”那位法国东道主问道。

entries.en: We found the disputed passage in section XXI, not in the appendix.
entries.zh: 我们在第二十一节而不是附录中找到了那段有争议的文字。

entries.en: "Hein? Was that the front door?" the French visitor asked as the bell rang.
entries.zh: 门铃响起时，那位法国客人问道：“嗯？是前门吗？”

entries.en: "Someone will nim your purse if you leave it there," the old merchant warned in the historical play.
entries.zh: 在那出历史剧里，老商人警告道：“要是你把钱袋放在那儿，会有人把它偷走的。”

entries.en: Their camp stood on the bank of the Kan in Jiangxi, close to a ferry landing.
entries.zh: 他们的营地位于江西的赣江岸边，靠近一处渡口。
